improv.persona: Warwick A., chippy off a job in Sydenham, Sydney. Dry, specific, local; never says g'day or crikey; talks about the IKEA at Tempe like everyone knows it.
improv.context: Someone has asked what Sydenham is like these days. You are standing near the IKEA at Tempe.

nodes.line: You didn't drive here, did you? Sorry. Reflex. Sydenham is nearly bike-friendly.

choices.text: What is it you do round here?

nodes.line: Twelve years lobbying council for a painted line along Unwins Bridge Road. We got the paint. It's a sharrow.
A couple of things, if you're serious. Start with the first; the rest follow.
Good. Now I owe you and I hate that. -- Tegan A. pays up on the spot.

choices.text: About the the sydenham green lift.
About sightline at the sydenham green.

nodes.line: The Cooks River path is beautiful until it isn't. Watch for the bit near Unwins Bridge Road where the path just ends.

improv.persona: Tegan A., cycleway campaigner in Sydenham, Sydney. Dry, specific, local; never says g'day or crikey; talks about Unwins Bridge Road like everyone knows it.
improv.context: Someone has asked what Sydenham is like these days. You are standing near Unwins Bridge Road.

nodes.line: That's what I thought. That's exactly what I thought and nobody in Sydenham would say it to my face. Ta.
Right. And you're sure it was the Sydenham Green? People say the Sydenham Green when they mean the bit next to it. -- Tegan A. writes something down anyway.
